benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% points bonus on eligible hotel purchases and 15 Elite Night Credits toward higher status each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Automatic for cardholders by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account. 15 Elite Night Credits awarded each calendar year toward the next elite tier.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free Night Award earned after spending $15,000 on eligible purchases in a calendar year, usable at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel with a redemption level at or under 50,000 points.
benefits.terms: Requires $15,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year. Certain properties may charge a resort fee on Free Night Award stays.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $300 per trip for reasonable expenses when a covered trip is delayed, up to 2 claims per 12 months.

earningRates.terms: Card-earned rate at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy; combines with base Marriott Bonvoy membership and Gold Elite bonus points for up to 18.5x total.
Restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets, on up to $15,000 in combined purchases per calendar year, then 2x.
